verdict.rationale: Lindy is itself an AI agent (an 'AI employee' or teammate), so serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The MCP evidence is client-side only: Lindy is pointed at external hosted MCP servers and builds actions from their tools. The probe's 'official MCP server' label refers to that same client-integration page, and nothing shows Lindy exposing its own MCP server endpoint.
